name: env
description: Environment overrides affect later tools and persist across turns/restarts. Results hide values. Unset removes overrides, not ambient defaults. Protected: RECURSE_*, PI_*, CHAT_DATA_DIR. Limits: 16,384 chars/value, 64 KiB total; multiline allowed.

path.description: Dotenv file for load; relative to cwd.

name: chdir
description: Change cwd for subsequent tools and turns.

directory.description: Relative paths use the current cwd.

name: publish
description: Publish files in the operator's reply and Files pane; images display inline. Other agents need file paths, not publication. Same filename adds a version. Limits: 100 MB/file, 120 files/minute. Text paths/links don't publish files.
